evidence.name: Screen field: Add an option value
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Add an option value" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Add an option value
sections.description: Type a value for a new option on this variable and click Add; it joins the options list and the mapping table below. Use a stable, lowercase, underscore-style value such as maintain_weight so routing and analytics stay clean. After adding it, map it to the matching on-screen item below — otherwise a visitor choosing that answer won't store anything.
